judge.rationale: The candidate fails to update `CHANGELOG.md`, which is an explicit acceptance criterion in the issue ('and the CHANGELOG entry states the change in what an existing consumer will record') and even noted as unchecked in its own `.lore/dod.md`. Additionally, in `src/index.ts`, the candidate exports `TotalUsage` twice from two different module re-exports (`chatOrchestrator.js` and `./types/ai.js`), which can cause duplicate identifier errors in TypeScript compilation. Otherwise, the core logic in `accumulateUsage` and `chatOrchestrator.ts` is sound, introducing a `TotalUsage` type alias and updating the parameter name to `totalUsage`. While the reference kept `accumulateUsage` private to `chatOrchestrator.ts` and added tests to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the candidate placed the helper in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` and created a new acceptance test file, which is an acceptable structural choice.
